description: The Central Statistics Office of Dominica publishes its 2011 Population and Housing Census report as a PDF and repeats several housing tables as web pages under demographic statistics. The report's housing chapter cross-tabulates households by type of dwelling against outer wall material, roofing material, year built, water facility, toilet facility, lighting and cooking facility, and adds appliances, vehicles and internet access, each with a trend table back to earlier censuses. The web table on water shows the share of households with public water piped into the dwelling rising from 12.7 percent in 1981 to 64.8 percent in 2011, while use of public standpipes fell from 47.3 to 14.5 percent. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF and HTML tables, no registration; reports for 2001, 1991 and regional Caribbean censuses of 1980 and 1990 are also posted. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: housing tables are national with no parish split; the census page describes a newer census, but no results from it were found on the site. Simulation uses: housing stock material and age for hurricane damage models, and water and power access trends. Related records: none for Dominica censuses in the catalogue.
